node (tsx) direct exercise of apps/web/lib/navigation/tree.ts resolveActive() against accrualsHref/accrualCreateHref/accrualDetailHref -> clientLeaf is null for all three routes, i.e. the newly added 'accrualNew'/'accrualDetail' CLIENT_LEAVES rows and leafFor branches never fire

findings.what: The two new breadcrumb leaves for the accrual form and detail pages are dead code: they can never be produced by resolveActive(), so the breadcrumb never deepens past 'Accruals' for /accruals/new or /accruals/:id, contradicting the code's own comments ('the DETAIL leaf is viewer...', 'a durable record cannot be a static menu row'). Root cause: 'accruals' was correctly registered as its own top-level ACCOUNTING_ITEMS row (segment 'accruals', per the brief's routing ruling), so resolveActive's ACCOUNTING_ITEMS match fires on rest[0]==='accruals' alone -- before rest.length or rest[1] is ever inspected -- and short-circuits before reaching CLIENT_NAV.find/leafFor, where the new branches live. journalComposer/periodicAdjustment (the pattern this was copied from) only work because THEIR routes sit under the literal 'accounting/...' CLIENT_NAV segment, a structurally different case. 'plans' -- the exact precedent for a top-level ACCOUNTING_ITEMS segment -- correctly carries no leaf at all.
findings.evidence: Direct execution: resolveActive('/clients/<id>/accruals')/(.../accruals/new)/(.../accruals/acc-1) all return {clientItem:null, accountingItem:'accruals', clientLeaf:null}. No test anywhere (tree.test.ts, routes.test.ts) asserts clientLeaf for any accrual route; routes.test.ts only exercises the unrelated command-palette href builders.
findings.fix: Remove the accrualNew/accrualDetail members from ClientLeafId, their two CLIENT_LEAVES rows, and the two dead leafFor branches -- mirroring 'plans', which needs no leaf for the same reason. If per-page breadcrumb differentiation is actually wanted, it requires resolveActive's ACCOUNTING_ITEMS branch itself to call leafFor for top-level items (a design change beyond one-line registration, and out of this ticket's minimal-shared-edit mandate).

findings.what: AC6 and the brief's own §3 state list ('empty (first use vs filtered no-results vs valid no-data)') require the list's empty state to be verified with its own cell. No test -- neither accrual-walk.spec.ts's 14 cells nor accrual-form.test.tsx's 11 -- exercises AccrualsList with zero rows; the mock always seeds at least one posted and one configured accrual. The final report marks AC6 'done' on the strength of those 25 cells, which is an overstatement for this one explicitly-named state.
findings.evidence: grep for 'No accruals recorded' / empty-state assertions across accrual-form.test.tsx and accrual-walk.spec.ts returns nothing; accruals-list.tsx has no component test file at all (only accrual-form.test.tsx and accrual-draft.test.ts were added, confirmed by the branch's diffstat).
findings.fix: Add one cell (component test on AccrualsList with an empty API response, or a walk cell against a client with zero accruals) asserting the empty message renders; then AC6's 'done' claim is fully evidenced rather than resting on the shared DataState primitive's behavior elsewhere in the app.
